description.fun: Caterpie's big yellow eye rings are fakes, there to scare off predators, and the red antenna on its head gives off a stink to drive them away. It's easy to catch, grows fast and eats a hundred leaves a day, which makes it ideal for new Trainers. It was the first Pokémon caught in the animated series, and the first to evolve there too.
description.guide: A green caterpillar Pokémon with eye-like markings and a red antenna that releases a foul smell to repel predators. It eats huge amounts of leaves, grows quickly and is easy to catch, which makes it a good first Pokémon. It evolves into Metapod and then Butterfree.
description.tagline: A hungry green caterpillar with fake eyes and a stinky antenna

description.fun: Metapod's shell is said to be as hard as steel, which is just as well, because all it can do is harden it further. Inside, its soft body is rebuilding its cells to become Butterfree, and a sudden, powerful knock could burst the shell and leave its liquid insides exposed. It keeps on hardening even in its sleep.
description.guide: The cocoon stage of Caterpie's line. Its hard green shell protects the soft body inside while it undergoes metamorphosis, and it barely moves, only hardening its shell further when threatened. It evolves into Butterfree.
description.tagline: A steel-hard cocoon whose only trick is getting harder

description.fun: Butterfree's wings are dusted with poisonous scales that fall off as it flies, and the same powder repels water, so it can keep gathering nectar in the rain. Its antennae can smell blooming flowers 10 km away. It's often paired with Beedrill, likely a nod to the boxing line 'float like a butterfly, sting like a bee', which the English anime turned into 'floating like a Butterfree and stinging like a Beedrill'.
description.guide: A Bug and Flying Pokémon resembling a purple butterfly with large red eyes and white wings. Its wings shed poisonous, water-repellent scales, and its antennae can sense flowers about 10 km away. It is the final stage of Caterpie's line and has a Gigantamax form.
description.tagline: The butterfly half of 'float like a butterfly, sting like a bee'

description.fun: Its wings turn bright green, and it scatters glittering scales of crystallised Gigantamax energy that can paralyse, poison or put foes to sleep, carried on winds strong enough to lift a 10-ton truck.
